title: The Rabbit Who Waited for the Moon
menuLabel: the rabbit who waited for the moon

pages.text: In a burrow under the old oak tree lived a small brown rabbit named Juniper, who was very good at waiting.
Every evening Juniper sat in the meadow and watched the sky, because the moon had promised to come back.
Some nights the clouds were thick and the moon was hidden. Juniper waited anyway. Waiting is a kind of loving.
And then, quiet as anything, the moon rose over the hill. There you are, said Juniper. Goodnight, {child}.
